correctness.rationale: Exact ABC reduction yields an energy-dependent axial advance and the explicit transverse quadrature. Two endpoint singularities give T=(2/B)log[4B^2/(E^2-delta^2)]+O(1) uniformly. Optimization in E=delta(1+t) yields 2log(1/delta)+loglog(1/delta)+O(1); off-window energies are excluded. Rational double preimages follow by continuity. The proof separately establishes the hypotheses and endpoint control; numerical checks are not used to assert infinite conclusions.
